Use SQL Server 2019+ in a separate practice database with a SQL editor. T-SQL is different from the SQLite engine on this site, so these examples are for that separate tool.

blocks.title: Summarise groups

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `ORDER BY` chooses a result order. Include a tie-break field when equal values need a stable order.
`GROUP BY` makes one summary group for each distinct combination of the named grouping values.
`SELECT` names the output values. `AS` can give a calculated result a readable column name.

blocks.text: Blue totals 5 books, and Green totals 4.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: SUM adds values; COUNT counts rows. Choose the function that answers your question.
